verses.original: δὲ διὰ τῆς πραΰτητος καὶ ἐπιεικείας τοῦ Χριστοῦ παρακαλῶ Αὐτὸς ὑμᾶς ἐγὼ Παῦλος ὃς μὲν ταπεινὸς κατὰ πρόσωπον ἐν ὑμῖν δὲ θαρρῶ εἰς ὑμᾶς ἀπὼν
verses.transliteration: de dia tēs prautētos kai epieikeias tou Christou parakalō Autos hymas egō Paulos hos men tapeinos kata prosōpon en hymin de tharrō eis hymas apōn
verses.literal: Now by the mildness and gentleness - of Christ I appeal . . . to you I Paul who - [am] humble vvv when face to face with you but bold - - when away

verses.original: δὲ δέομαι τὸ παρὼν μὴ θαρρῆσαι τῇ πεποιθήσει τολμῆσαι ᾗ λογίζομαι ἐπί τινας τοὺς λογιζομένους ἡμᾶς ὡς περιπατοῦντας κατὰ σάρκα
verses.transliteration: de deomai to parōn mē tharrēsai tē pepoithēsei tolmēsai hē logizomai epi tinas tous logizomenous hēmas hōs peripatountas kata sarka
verses.literal: - I beg [you] that when I come vvv I may not need to be vvv as bold . . . as I expect toward [those] who presume that we - live according to [the] flesh

verses.original: γὰρ περιπατοῦντες Ἐν σαρκὶ οὐ στρατευόμεθα κατὰ σάρκα
verses.transliteration: gar peripatountes En sarki ou strateuometha kata sarka
verses.literal: For though we live in [the] flesh vvv we do not wage war according to [the] flesh

verses.original: γὰρ τὰ ὅπλα τῆς ἡμῶν στρατείας οὐ σαρκικὰ ἀλλὰ τῷ Θεῷ δυνατὰ πρὸς καθαίρεσιν ὀχυρωμάτων
verses.transliteration: gar ta hopla tēs hēmōn strateias ou sarkika alla tō Theō dynata pros kathairesin ochyrōmatōn
verses.literal: - The weapons of our warfare [are] not [ the weapons ] of the flesh Instead [they have] divine power to demolish strongholds

verses.original: καθαιροῦντες λογισμοὺς καὶ πᾶν ὕψωμα ἐπαιρόμενον κατὰ τῆς γνώσεως τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ αἰχμαλωτίζοντες πᾶν νόημα εἰς τὴν ὑπακοὴν τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: kathairountes logismous kai pan hypsōma epairomenon kata tēs gnōseōs tou Theou kai aichmalōtizontes pan noēma eis tēn hypakoēn tou Christou
verses.literal: We demolish arguments and every presumption set up against the knowledge - of God and we take captive every thought to - make it obedient - to Christ

verses.original: καὶ ἐν ἔχοντες ἑτοίμῳ ἐκδικῆσαι πᾶσαν παρακοήν ὅταν ὑμῶν ἡ ὑπακοή πληρωθῇ
verses.transliteration: kai en echontes hetoimō ekdikēsai pasan parakoēn hotan hymōn hē hypakoē plērōthē
verses.literal: And we will be ready to punish every [act of] disobedience as soon as your - obedience is complete

verses.original: βλέπετε Τὰ κατὰ πρόσωπον εἴ τις πέποιθεν ἑαυτῷ εἶναι Χριστοῦ τοῦτο λογιζέσθω πάλιν ἐφ’ ἑαυτοῦ ὅτι ἡμεῖς οὕτως καὶ καθὼς αὐτὸς Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: blepete Ta kata prosōpon ei tis pepoithen heautō einai Christou touto logizesthō palin eph’ heautou hoti hēmeis houtōs kai kathōs autos Christou
verses.literal: You are looking - at outward appearances If anyone is confident that he belongs to Christ - he should remind . . . vvv himself that we [belong to Christ] just as much as he [does]

verses.original: γὰρ τε ἐάν καυχήσωμαι τι περισσότερόν περὶ τῆς ἐξουσίας ἧς ὁ Κύριος ἔδωκεν ἡμῶν εἰς οἰκοδομὴν καὶ οὐκ εἰς καθαίρεσιν ὑμῶν οὐκ αἰσχυνθήσομαι
verses.transliteration: gar te ean kauchēsōmai ti perissoteron peri tēs exousias hēs ho Kyrios edōken hēmōn eis oikodomēn kai ouk eis kathairesin hymōn ouk aischynthēsomai
verses.literal: For even if I boast somewhat excessively about the authority - the Lord gave us for building [you] up rather than . . . - tearing you down . . . vvv I will not be ashamed

verses.original: ἵνα μὴ δόξω ὡς ἂν ἐκφοβεῖν ὑμᾶς διὰ τῶν ἐπιστολῶν
verses.transliteration: hina mē doxō hōs an ekphobein hymas dia tōn epistolōn
verses.literal: - vvv I do not want to seem to be . . . [trying] to frighten you by [my] letters

verses.original: Ὅτι φησίν Αἱ ἐπιστολαὶ μέν Βαρεῖαι καὶ ἰσχυραί δὲ τοῦ σώματος ἡ παρουσία ἀσθενὴς καὶ ὁ λόγος ἐξουθενημένος
verses.transliteration: Hoti phēsin Hai epistolai men Bareiai kai ischyrai de tou sōmatos hē parousia asthenēs kai ho logos exouthenēmenos
verses.literal: For [some] say [His] letters - [are] weighty and forceful but his physical - presence [is] unimpressive and [his] speaking [is] of no account

verses.original: ὁ τοιοῦτος λογιζέσθω τοῦτο ὅτι οἷοί ἐσμεν δι’ τῷ λόγῳ ἐπιστολῶν ἀπόντες τοιοῦτοι καὶ τῷ ἔργῳ παρόντες
verses.transliteration: ho toioutos logizesthō touto hoti hoioi esmen di’ tō logō epistolōn apontes toioutoi kai tō ergō parontes
verses.literal: - Such [people] should consider - that what we are in vvv vvv [our] letters when absent [we will be] . . . - in our actions when present

verses.original: γὰρ τολμῶμεν Οὐ ἐνκρῖναι ἢ συνκρῖναι ἑαυτούς τισιν τῶν συνιστανόντων ἑαυτοὺς ἀλλὰ αὐτοὶ μετροῦντες ἑαυτοὺς ἐν ἑαυτοῖς καὶ συνκρίνοντες ἑαυτοὺς ἑαυτοῖς οὐ συνιᾶσιν
verses.transliteration: gar tolmōmen Ou enkrinai ē synkrinai heautous tisin tōn synistanontōn heautous alla autoi metrountes heautous en heautois kai synkrinontes heautous heautois ou syniasin
verses.literal: - We do not dare - to classify or compare ourselves [with] some who commend themselves - [When] they measure themselves by themselves and compare themselves with themselves vvv they show their ignorance

verses.original: ἡμεῖς δὲ οὐκ καυχησόμεθα εἰς τὰ ἄμετρα ἀλλὰ κατὰ τὸ μέτρον τοῦ κανόνος οὗ ὁ Θεὸς ἐμέρισεν ἡμῖν μέτρου ἐφικέσθαι καὶ ἄχρι ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: hēmeis de ouk kauchēsometha eis ta ametra alla kata to metron tou kanonos hou ho Theos emerisen hēmin metrou ephikesthai kai achri hymōn
verses.literal: We however vvv will not boast vvv vvv beyond our limits but only within the field of influence . . . . . . that - God has assigned to us a field that reaches even to you

verses.original: γὰρ οὐ ὑπερεκτείνομεν ἑαυτούς ὡς μὴ ἐφικνούμενοι εἰς ὑμᾶς γὰρ καὶ ἐφθάσαμεν ἄχρι ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar ou hyperekteinomen heautous hōs mē ephiknoumenoi eis hymas gar kai ephthasamen achri hymōn en tō euangeliō tou Christou
verses.literal: - vvv We are not overstepping our [bounds] as if vvv we had not come to you Indeed - we were the first to reach . . . you with the gospel - of Christ

verses.original: οὐκ καυχώμενοι εἰς τὰ ἄμετρα ἐν κόποις ἀλλοτρίοις δὲ ἔχοντες ἐλπίδα ὑμῶν τῆς πίστεως αὐξανομένης ἡμῶν τὸν κανόνα ἐν ὑμῖν κατὰ μεγαλυνθῆναι εἰς περισσείαν
verses.transliteration: ouk kauchōmenoi eis ta ametra en kopois allotriois de echontes elpida hymōn tēs pisteōs auxanomenēs hēmōn ton kanona en hymin kata megalynthēnai eis perisseian
verses.literal: Neither do we boast vvv vvv beyond our limits in [the] labors of others But vvv we hope that [as] your - faith increases our - area of influence among you - will greatly increase [ as well ] . . . . . .

verses.original: εἰς εὐαγγελίσασθαι τὰ ὑπερέκεινα ὑμῶν οὐκ καυχήσασθαι ἐν τὰ ἕτοιμα εἰς ἀλλοτρίῳ κανόνι
verses.transliteration: eis euangelisasthai ta hyperekeina hymōn ouk kauchēsasthai en ta hetoima eis allotriō kanoni
verses.literal: so that we can preach the gospel [in the regions] beyond you vvv [Then] we will not be boasting in the [work] already done in another man’s territory

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ καυχώμενος καυχάσθω ἐν Κυρίῳ
verses.transliteration: de Ho kauchōmenos kauchasthō en Kyriō
verses.literal: Rather {Let} him who boasts boast in [the] Lord

verses.original: γὰρ ἐστιν οὐ ὁ συνιστάνων ἑαυτὸν ἐκεῖνός δόκιμος ἀλλὰ ὃν ὁ Κύριος συνίστησιν
verses.transliteration: gar estin ou ho synistanōn heauton ekeinos dokimos alla hon ho Kyrios synistēsin
verses.literal: For it is not the [one] who commends himself [who is] approved but the one whom the Lord commends
